correctness.rationale: The exact Fourier coefficient convolution gives 11 Laurent monomials and formula (1). The change of variables yields a sharp cubic envelope; the unique interior root is global. Equality conditions force exactly two conjugate unit-phase orbits. Degree(P^3)=9 proves N>=10 quadrature exact; the N=9 strict counterexample is checked in Q(sqrt(15)) via Chebyshev values. The standalone source checker independently confirms all finite algebraic certificates, and the infinite claims are proved analytically.
